title: Pure Mokey Mokey
summary: Pure Mokey Mokey swarm and OTK beatdown deck, supercharged by Mokey Mokey Adrift and generic Normal Monster support. The strategy floods the field with Level 1 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monsters, crashing a Fairy to trigger Mokey Mokey Smackdown and instantly transform every Mokey Mokey into a 3000 ATK attacker.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mokey Mokey Adrift discards itself from hand to add any Mokey Mokey card from Deck to hand, counts as a Normal Monster on field and in GY, and Tributes itself to revive as many Mokey Mokeys as possible from the GY.
Unexpected Dai Special Summons Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Rescue Rabbit banishes itself to Special Summon two copies of Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck.
Painful Decision sends a Mokey Mokey from Deck to GY to add another copy to your hand, loading the GY for revival.
Fusion Deployment reveals Mokey Mokey King in your Extra Deck to Special Summon Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Mokey Mokey Adrift + Rescue Rabbit
steps: Discard Mokey Mokey Adrift from hand to search Mokey Mokey Smackdown from your Deck.
Normal Summon Rescue Rabbit and banish it to Special Summon two copies of Mokey Mokey from your Deck.
Link Summon Link Spider using one Mokey Mokey, then activate Link Spider's effect to Special Summon a Mokey Mokey from your hand if available.

Normal Summon or Special Summon The Agent of Creation - Venus, paying LP to summon Mystical Shine Ball, then crash Shine Ball in battle to trigger Mokey Mokey Smackdown and boost all Mokey Mokeys to 3000 ATK.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Mokey Mokey King is a Level 6 Fusion made from three Mokey Mokeys with Polymerization; when removed from the field, it Special Summons as many Mokey Mokey monsters as possible from your GY.
First of the Dragons is a Level 9 Dragon Fusion made with two Normal Monsters; it cannot be destroyed by battle except by a Normal Monster and is completely unaffected by other monster effects.
Link Spider converts a Normal Monster into an Effect body and extends from hand.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mokey Mokey Smackdown is the central win condition: whenever a face-up Fairy you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, the ATK of all Mokey Mokey monsters you control becomes 3000 until the end of the turn.
Polymerization fuses materials into Mokey Mokey King or First of the Dragons while filling the GY with Mokey Mokeys for mass revival.
Fusion Deployment and Unexpected Dai provide immediate Deck access to Mokey Mokey.
Painful Decision searches and loads the graveyard simultaneously.

main: Mokey Mokey

Iconic Level 1 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster (300 ATK / 100 DEF): summoned from the Deck via Unexpected Dai, Rescue Rabbit, and Fusion Deployment, and reaches 3000 ATK whenever Mokey Mokey Smackdown triggers!
Mokey Mokey Adrift

Core Level 1 LIGHT Fairy: treated as 'Mokey Mokey' and as a Normal Monster while on the field or in the GY; discards itself to add ANY 'Mokey Mokey' card from your Deck to your hand; and Tributes itself to revive as many 'Mokey Mokey' monsters as possible from your GY!
Mokey Mokey Smackdown

Signature Continuous Spell: while you control a face-up 'Mokey Mokey', if a face-up Fairy monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, the ATK of ALL 'Mokey Mokey' monsters you control becomes 3000!
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Mokey Mokey from your Deck.
Painful Decision
Sends 1 Mokey Mokey from your Deck to the GY to add a second copy to your hand.
Fusion Deployment
Reveals Mokey Mokey King in your Extra Deck to Special Summon Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck.
Polymerization
Fuses 3 Mokey Mokeys into Mokey Mokey King (or 2 into First of the Dragons).
The Agent of Creation - Venus

LIGHT Fairy starter that summons Mystical Shine Balls to crash in battle—destroying a face-up Fairy you control so Mokey Mokey Smackdown immediately turns all your Mokey Mokeys into 3000 ATK beatsticks!
Mystical Shine Ball
Summoned by Venus to crash into an opponent's monster and trigger Mokey Mokey Smackdown during your Battle Phase.
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Mokey Mokey Adrift directly from your Deck.
extra: Signature Level 6 LIGHT Fairy Fusion boss ('Mokey Mokey' + 'Mokey Mokey' + 'Mokey Mokey'): when this card is removed from the field, Special Summons as many 'Mokey Mokey' monsters as possible from your GY!
Level 9 Dragon Fusion made with any 2 Mokey Mokey Normal Monsters via Polymerization.
Link-1 monster that converts Mokey Mokey into an Effect Monster and extends from hand.
